title: 70 Million Chinese People Are Gone Forever: Author Discusses Brutality of CCP's One-Child Policy, Forced Organ Harvesting | NTD
text:
Steven Mosher, author of "The Devil and Communist China," and president of the Population Research Institute, discussed with NTD's Steve Lance his eyewitness experience as part of scholarly group exchange to China in the 1970s.
Mosher discussed the Chinese Communist Party's (CCP) brutal slaying of Chinese babies in their mothers' wombs in late-term pregnancies and as they were being born, as part of China's forced one-child policy, and the epidemic of suicide of Chinese women that followed the mass slaughter of innocent babies.
Mosher also discussed how forced organ harvesting has become big business in China, where the CCP targets Falun Gong practitioners, other minority groups, and political prisoners, and how China uses a life-saving medical procedure developed in the United States to make forced organ harvesting in China more profitable.
Mosher also discussed how China's one-child policy has decimated its population—and, consequently, its economy—how CCP leader Xi Jinping's days in the party are numbered, and how the United States can solve China's ceaseless war on the United States.
